project.name: NEXUM
project.description:
A FIX order router, and a harness for testing one.
The harness is its own module because it is its own thing: it stands FIX endpoints up against a system under test, and which system that is has nothing to do with this engine. Living inside the engine made it reachable only by running one — a spare configuration and a placeholder session, for a process meant to route nothing.
